styles.name: Minimal
styles.hint: Lots of white space, few colors, nothing extra. The content does the talking.
styles.guidance: Restraint above all: generous whitespace, a near-monochrome palette with one accent used sparingly, thin 1px rules instead of boxes, no gradients, no decorative shadows. Typography carries the hierarchy.
styles.best_for: Enterprise apps, dashboards, documentation sites, SaaS platforms, professional tools
styles.avoid_for: Creative portfolios, entertainment, playful brands, artistic experiments

recipe.effects: Subtle hover (200-250ms), smooth transitions, sharp shadows if any, clear type hierarchy, fast loading
recipe.css: display: grid, gap: 2rem, font-family: sans-serif, color: #000 or #FFF, max-width: 1200px, clean borders, no box-shadow unless necessary
checklist: text contrast measured against the chosen project target

styles.name: Modern SaaS
styles.hint: Clean product look with soft gradients, cards and a product screenshot. Familiar and polished.
styles.guidance: Polished product marketing: a soft gradient or glow behind the hero, a framed product screenshot, rounded cards with subtle shadows, a clear primary CTA plus a secondary ghost button, logo strip for social proof.
styles.best_for: SaaS, B2B tools, productivity apps, startups
styles.avoid_for: Luxury, editorial publishing, playful consumer brands, audiences wary of tech polish

recipe.effects: Hover lift (translateY(-2px) plus one shadow step, 150-200ms), gentle fade-up entrance
recipe.css: Hero: one radial-gradient glow (primary/accent at 10-20% alpha) behind a framed product screenshot; frame: 1px border, large radius, layered shadow; cards: 12-16px radius, shadow 0 1px 2px + 0 8px 24px at 6-8% alpha; filled primary button + ghost secondary; sections alternate bg and surface bands
recipe.tokens: --radius-lg: 16px, --shadow-card: 0 1px 2px rgb(0 0 0 / .06), 0 8px 24px rgb(0 0 0 / .06), --glow: radial-gradient(60% 50% at 50% 0%, primary 15%, transparent)
checklist: One glow or gradient field in the hero, not several
Filled primary CTA plus ghost secondary
Logo or social-proof strip right under the hero
All cards share one radius and shadow

styles.name: Editorial
styles.hint: Feels like a well-designed magazine: big serif headlines, strong columns, confident type.
styles.guidance: Magazine layout: large expressive serif display type, asymmetric columns, pull quotes, small-caps labels, hairline rules, generous measure control (60–75ch). Color is mostly paper and ink with one accent.
styles.best_for: News sites, blogs, magazines, editorial content, long-form articles, journalism, publishing
styles.avoid_for: Dashboards, apps, e-commerce catalogs, real-time data, short-form content

recipe.effects: Smooth scroll, reveal on scroll, parallax images, text animations, page-flip transitions
recipe.css: display: grid with named areas, column-count for text, ::first-letter for drop caps, blockquote styling, figure/figcaption, gap variations, font: serif for body, variable widths

styles.name: Playful
styles.hint: Bright, rounded and friendly, with fun shapes. Makes a product feel approachable.
styles.guidance: Friendly and bouncy: rounded shapes, blob or squiggle decorations, two cheerful accent colors, chunky rounded buttons, slight rotations on stickers/badges, warm conversational copy.
styles.best_for: Consumer apps, education, family, community, food and hobby products
styles.avoid_for: Finance, legal, healthcare, enterprise, grief or crisis contexts

recipe.effects: Bouncy hover (translateY(-2px) rotate(-1deg), cubic-bezier(.34,1.56,.64,1), 180ms), small wiggle on icons
recipe.css: border-radius 20-28px and pill buttons; decorative SVG blobs/squiggles (aria-hidden) behind sections; badges and stickers rotated -4deg to 4deg; tinted section backgrounds in the two accents; chunky buttons with a solid bottom shadow (0 4px 0 a darker shade of the fill)
checklist: At least one hand-made decoration (blob, squiggle, sticker)

styles.name: Bold / Brutalist
styles.hint: Raw and loud: thick borders, hard shadows, huge type. Memorable and opinionated.
styles.guidance: Neo-brutalist: thick black borders, hard offset shadows (no blur), oversized uppercase type, flat saturated blocks of color, visible grid, no rounded corners, deliberately blunt.
styles.best_for: Gen Z brands, startups, creative agencies, Figma-style apps, Notion-style interfaces, tech blogs
styles.avoid_for: Luxury brands, finance, healthcare, conservative industries (too playful)

recipe.effects: box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 #000, border: 3px solid #000, no gradients, sharp corners (0px), bold typography
recipe.css: border: 3px solid black, box-shadow: 5px 5px 0px black, colors: #FFDB58 #FF6B6B #4ECDC4, font-weight: 700, no gradients

styles.name: Corporate / Trustworthy
styles.hint: Conservative and reassuring. Good for finance, B2B, healthcare and legal.
styles.guidance: Reassuring and orderly: a structured 12-column grid, navy or deep-blue primary, restrained imagery, trust markers (logos, certifications, numbers), modest radii, clear secondary navigation.
styles.best_for: Finance, insurance, legal, B2B services, healthcare providers, government
styles.avoid_for: Youth brands, entertainment, creative studios, playful consumer products

recipe.effects: 150ms color and underline hovers; at most a short fade on entrance
recipe.css: 12-column grid, max-width ~1200px; radius 4-8px; 1px borders preferred over shadows; stat blocks with font-variant-numeric: tabular-nums; trust strip (logos, certifications, ratings); restrained imagery; clear secondary navigation
checklist: Modest radii and borders, no playful decoration

styles.name: Luxury
styles.hint: Dark, elegant and spacious, with refined serif type. Premium and unhurried.
styles.guidance: Premium and quiet: deep backgrounds or ivory, thin elegant serif display, wide letter-spacing on small caps labels, gold/champagne accent used sparingly, lots of breathing room, slow subtle motion.
styles.best_for: Premium brands, hospitality, fashion, real estate, fine dining, jewelry
styles.avoid_for: Budget or discount offers, data-heavy tools, urgent conversion pages

recipe.effects: Slow fades (600-900ms ease-out); image scale 1.03 on hover; nothing bounces
recipe.css: Display serif at large sizes (clamp up to ~6rem), weight 300-500; small-caps or uppercase labels with letter-spacing .2em; section padding 8-12rem on desktop; 1px hairline rules in the accent; full-bleed image placeholders; very few elements per screen
checklist: Accent used only for hairlines and one action

styles.name: Technical / Dev-tool
styles.hint: Dark UI, monospace accents and code snippets. Speaks the language of developers.
styles.guidance: Developer-native: dark surfaces, monospace labels and code blocks, terminal motifs, grid/dot backgrounds, crisp 1px borders, keyboard-shortcut chips, precise data and changelog-style details.
styles.best_for: Developer tools, APIs, infrastructure, security, data products
styles.avoid_for: Consumer lifestyle, older or non-technical audiences, wellness

recipe.effects: 120ms hovers, blinking cursor via steps() keyframes, no bounce
recipe.css: Dark surfaces separated by 1px borders; monospace for labels, numbers and code; dot or line grid background (radial-gradient/linear-gradient at 6-10% alpha); code blocks with syntax tints; kbd chips (1px border plus a 2px bottom border); terminal window frame with three dots
checklist: Real commands or code in the hero
Monospace only for code, numbers and labels

styles.name: Swiss modernism
styles.hint: A strict grid, big clean type and one bright accent. Rational and confident.
styles.guidance: International style: a visible 12-column grid, asymmetric but mathematical placement, large grotesque headlines, flush-left ragged-right text, one vivid accent, no decoration.
styles.best_for: Corporate sites, architecture, editorial, SaaS, museums, professional services, documentation
styles.avoid_for: Playful brands, children's sites, entertainment, gaming, emotional storytelling

recipe.effects: display: grid, grid-template-columns: repeat(12 1fr), gap: 1rem, mathematical ratios, clear hierarchy
recipe.css: display: grid, grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr), gap: 1rem (8px base unit), font-family: Inter/Helvetica, font-weight: 400-700, color: #000/#FFF, single accent

styles.name: Exaggerated minimalism
styles.hint: Huge statement type and lots of empty space. Loud by saying very little.
styles.guidance: Oversized display type (up to 10vw) carries the page; extreme negative space; black/white plus one accent; almost no other elements.
styles.best_for: Fashion, architecture, portfolios, agency landing pages, luxury brands, editorial
styles.avoid_for: E-commerce catalogs, dashboards, forms, data-heavy, elderly users, complex apps

recipe.effects: font-size: clamp(3rem 10vw 12rem), font-weight: 900, letter-spacing: -0.05em, massive whitespace
recipe.css: font-size: clamp(3rem, 10vw, 12rem), font-weight: 900, letter-spacing: -0.05em, color: #000 or #FFF, padding: 8rem+, single accent, no decorations

styles.name: Bento grid
styles.hint: Features as a mosaic of tiles in different sizes. Modern and easy to scan.
styles.guidance: Modular tiles of varied spans (2x2, 2x1, 1x1) on a neutral ground, each tile one idea with a visual inside, consistent large radius.
styles.best_for: Dashboards, product pages, portfolios, Apple-style marketing, feature showcases, SaaS
styles.avoid_for: Dense data tables, text-heavy content, real-time monitoring

recipe.effects: grid-template with varied spans, rounded-xl (16px), subtle shadows, hover scale (1.02), smooth transitions
recipe.css: display: grid, grid-template-columns: repeat(4, 1fr), grid-auto-rows: 200px, gap: 16px, border-radius: 24px, background: #FFFFFF, box-shadow: 0 4px 6px rgba(0,0,0,0.05)

styles.name: Glass
styles.hint: Frosted translucent panels over a colorful background. Light, layered and modern.
styles.guidance: Translucent blurred panels over a vivid gradient or shape field; thin light borders; depth from layering. Contrast must be checked on every panel.
styles.best_for: Modern SaaS, financial dashboards, high-end corporate, lifestyle apps, modal overlays, navigation
styles.avoid_for: Low-contrast backgrounds, critical accessibility, performance-limited, dark text on dark

recipe.effects: Backdrop blur (10-20px), subtle border (1px solid rgba white 0.2), light reflection, Z-depth
recipe.css: backdrop-filter: blur(15px), background: rgba(255, 255, 255, 0.15), border: 1px solid rgba(255,255,255,0.2), -webkit-backdrop-filter: blur(15px), z-index layering for depth
recipe.tokens: --blur-amount: 15px, --glass-opacity: 0.15, --border-color: rgba(255,255,255,0.2), --background: vibrant color, --text-color: light/dark based on BG

styles.name: Aurora gradients
styles.hint: Soft glowing color fields like northern lights. Atmospheric and premium.
styles.guidance: Large blended mesh/radial gradients as the atmosphere behind calm content; slow drifting motion; content panels stay solid and readable.
styles.best_for: Modern SaaS, creative agencies, branding, music platforms, lifestyle, premium products, hero sections
styles.avoid_for: Data-heavy dashboards, critical accessibility, content-heavy where distraction issues

recipe.effects: Large flowing CSS/SVG gradients, subtle 8-12s animations, depth via color layering, smooth morph
recipe.css: background: conic-gradient or radial-gradient with multiple stops, animation: @keyframes gradient (8-12s), background-size: 200% 200%, filter: saturate(1.2), blend-mode: screen or multiply

styles.name: Clay
styles.hint: Chunky, soft 3D shapes like modelling clay. Friendly and tactile.
styles.guidance: Puffy rounded surfaces with inner+outer shadows, thick soft borders, pastel fills, squishy press states.
styles.best_for: Educational apps, children's apps, SaaS platforms, creative tools, fun-focused, onboarding, casual games
styles.avoid_for: Formal corporate, professional services, data-critical, serious/medical, legal apps, finance

recipe.effects: Inner+outer shadows (subtle, no hard lines), soft press (200ms ease-out), fluffy elements, smooth transitions
recipe.css: border-radius: 16-24px, border: 3-4px solid, box-shadow: inset -2px -2px 8px, 4px 4px 8px, background: pastel-gradient, animation: soft bounce (cubic-bezier 0.34, 1.56)

styles.name: Organic / biophilic
styles.hint: Natural curves, greens and earthy textures. Calm and alive.
styles.guidance: Flowing organic shapes and blob dividers, earthy greens and naturals, varied soft radii, subtle natural textures.
styles.best_for: Wellness apps, sustainability brands, eco products, health apps, meditation, organic food brands
styles.avoid_for: Tech-focused products, gaming, industrial, urban brands

recipe.effects: Rounded corners (16-24px), organic curves (border-radius variations), natural shadows, flowing SVG shapes
recipe.css: border-radius: 16-24px (varied), background: earth tones, SVG organic shapes (blob), box-shadow: natural soft, color: #228B22 #8B4513 #87CEEB, texture overlays (subtle)

styles.name: Nature distilled
styles.hint: Terracotta, sand, clay and wood tones. Warm, handmade and grounded.
styles.guidance: Muted earth palette, humanist type, grain texture, soft natural shadows and crafted details; quiet and tactile.
styles.best_for: Wellness brands, sustainable products, artisan goods, organic food, spa/beauty, home decor
styles.avoid_for: Tech startups, gaming, nightlife, corporate finance, high-energy brands

recipe.effects: Subtle parallax, natural easing (ease-out), texture overlays, grain effects, soft shadows
recipe.css: background: warm earth tones, color: #C67B5C #D4C4A8 #6B7B3C, border-radius: organic (varied), box-shadow: soft natural, texture overlays (grain), font: humanist sans-serif

styles.name: Paper / e-ink
styles.hint: Like reading a printed page: matte paper, ink-black type, no distractions.
styles.guidance: Paper-white ground, ink-black serif reading type, hairline rules, no gradients or motion, print-like calm.
styles.best_for: Reading apps, digital newspapers, minimal journals, distraction-free writing, slow-living brands
styles.avoid_for: Gaming, video platforms, high-energy marketing, dark mode dependent apps

recipe.effects: No motion blur, distinct page turns, grain/noise texture, sharp transitions (no fade)
recipe.css: background: #FDFBF7 (paper white), color: #1A1A1A, transition: none, font-family: serif for reading, no gradients, border: 1px solid #E0E0E0, texture overlay (noise)

styles.name: Flat
styles.hint: Solid colors, simple shapes, no shadows. Clear and direct.
styles.guidance: Solid color blocks, no shadows or gradients, simple geometric icons, bold sans type, small radii.
styles.best_for: Web apps, mobile apps, cross-platform, startup MVPs, user-friendly, SaaS, dashboards, corporate
styles.avoid_for: Complex 3D, premium/luxury, artistic portfolios, immersive experiences, high-detail

recipe.effects: No gradients/shadows, simple hover (color/opacity shift), fast loading, clean transitions (150-200ms ease), minimal icons
recipe.css: box-shadow: none, background: solid color, border-radius: 0-4px, color: solid (no gradients), fill: solid, stroke: 1-2px, font: bold sans-serif, icons: simplified SVG
recipe.tokens: --shadow: none, --color-palette: 4-6 solid, --border-radius: 2px, --gradient: none, --icons: simplified SVG, --animation: minimal 150-200ms

styles.name: Vibrant blocks
styles.hint: Big saturated color blocks and large type. Energetic and youthful.
styles.guidance: Full-width saturated color blocks, oversized type, duotone sections, bold color-shift hovers, generous gaps.
styles.best_for: Startups, creative agencies, gaming, social media, youth-focused, entertainment, consumer
styles.avoid_for: Financial institutions, healthcare, formal business, government, conservative, elderly

recipe.effects: Large sections (48px+ gaps), animated patterns, bold hover (color shift), scroll-snap, large type (32px+), 200-300ms
recipe.css: display: flex/grid with large gaps (48px+), font-size: 32px+, background: animated patterns (CSS), color: neon/vibrant colors, animation: continuous pattern movement
checklist: Text contrast checked on every block

styles.name: Memphis
styles.hint: 80s geometric shapes, squiggles and clashing colors. Loud and fun.
styles.guidance: Scattered geometric shapes (triangles, zigzags, dots) via clip-path and patterns, tilted elements, clashing brights, asymmetric layout.
styles.best_for: Creative agencies, music sites, youth brands, event promotion, artistic portfolios, entertainment
styles.avoid_for: Corporate finance, healthcare, legal, elderly users, conservative brands

recipe.effects: transform: rotate(), clip-path: polygon(), mix-blend-mode, repeating patterns, bold shapes
recipe.css: clip-path: polygon() for shapes, background: repeating patterns, transform: rotate() for tilted elements, mix-blend-mode for overlays, border: dashed/dotted patterns, bold sans-serif

styles.name: Bauhaus
styles.hint: Circles, squares and primary colors with hard shadows. Poster-like and architectural.
styles.guidance: Primary color blocking, circles and squares as structure, heavy uppercase geometric headlines, hard offset shadows, mechanical press states.
styles.best_for: Mobile-first apps needing high personality, onboarding flows, branding-forward product screens, artisan/design brands, editorial mobile experiences
styles.avoid_for: Enterprise dashboards, accessibility-critical contexts (requires extra a11y work), data-heavy screens, conservative industries

recipe.effects: Hard offset shadows (4px 4px 0px black), mechanical press active:translate, no smooth hover — instant 0ms transitions, dot grid pattern on sections, slide-over transitions
recipe.css: border-radius 0 for blocks and inputs, 999px for buttons; box-shadow: 4px 4px 0 0 ink; 2px solid ink borders; active state translates 2px and drops the shadow; heavy uppercase geometric headlines with tight tracking; circles and squares as layout elements; dot-grid section backgrounds

styles.name: Retro-futurism
styles.hint: 80s sci-fi: neon glow, grids and scanlines. Nostalgic and electric.
styles.guidance: Synthwave neon on deep backgrounds, perspective grids, CRT scanline overlay, glow text, chrome accents.
styles.best_for: Gaming, entertainment, music platforms, tech brands, artistic projects, nostalgic, cyberpunk
styles.avoid_for: Conservative industries, critical accessibility, professional/corporate, elderly, legal/finance

recipe.effects: CRT scanlines (::before overlay), neon glow (text-shadow+box-shadow), glitch effects (skew/offset keyframes)
recipe.css: color: neon colors (#0080FF, #FF006E, #00FFFF), text-shadow: 0 0 10px neon, background: #000 or #1A1A2E, font-family: monospace, animation: glitch (skew+offset), filter: hue-rotate
checklist: Neon accents on a deep background
Glitch animation subtle and off under reduced motion

styles.name: Cyberpunk
styles.hint: Dark, neon and glitchy, like a sci-fi interface.
styles.guidance: Near-black HUD panels, neon accents, monospace readouts, subtle glitch and scanlines, angular frames.
styles.best_for: Gaming platforms, tech products, crypto apps, sci-fi applications, developer tools, entertainment
styles.avoid_for: Corporate enterprise, healthcare, family apps, conservative brands, elderly users

recipe.effects: Neon glow (text-shadow), glitch animations (skew/offset), scanlines (::before overlay), terminal fonts
recipe.css: background: #0D0D0D, color: #00FF00 or #FF00FF, font-family: monospace, text-shadow: 0 0 10px neon, animation: glitch (transform skew), ::before scanlines (repeating-linear-gradient)

styles.name: Y2K
styles.hint: Chrome, bubbles and glossy pinks from the 2000s. Playful nostalgia.
styles.guidance: Glossy chrome and iridescent gradients, bubble shapes, sparkles, candy colors, retro-futurist type.
styles.best_for: Fashion brands, music platforms, Gen Z brands, nostalgia marketing, entertainment, youth-focused
styles.avoid_for: B2B enterprise, healthcare, finance, conservative industries, elderly users

recipe.effects: linear-gradient metallic, glossy buttons, 3D chrome effects, glow animations, bubble shapes
recipe.css: background: linear-gradient(135deg, #FF69B4, #00FFFF), filter: drop-shadow for glow, border-radius: 50% for bubbles, metallic gradients (silver/chrome), text-shadow: neon glow, ::before for sparkles

styles.name: Layered depth
styles.hint: Cards and panels that float and overlap. Rich and spatial.
styles.guidance: Deliberate overlaps and a 4-level elevation scale; panels float over each other to show hierarchy.
styles.best_for: Dashboards, card layouts, modals, navigation, product showcases, SaaS interfaces
styles.avoid_for: Print-style layouts, simple blogs, low-end devices, flat design requirements

recipe.effects: z-index stacking, box-shadow elevation (4 levels), transform: translateZ(), backdrop-filter, parallax
recipe.css: z-index: 1-4 levels, box-shadow: elevation scale (sm/md/lg/xl), transform: translateZ(), backdrop-filter: blur(), position: relative for stacking, parallax on scroll

styles.name: Kinetic type
styles.hint: Type that moves and morphs. Headline-first and dynamic.
styles.guidance: Typography is the visual: animated or clipped gradient headlines, marquee or staggered letter reveals (CSS only), strong static fallback.
styles.best_for: Hero sections, marketing sites, video platforms, storytelling, creative portfolios, landing pages
styles.avoid_for: Long-form content, accessibility-critical, data interfaces, forms, elderly users

recipe.effects: @keyframes text animation, typing effect, background-clip: text, GSAP ScrollTrigger, split text
recipe.css: @keyframes on headline words (CSS only, no JS libraries), background-clip: text gradients, typing effect with steps(), staggered animation-delay per word, variable font weight transitions
checklist: Only the hero and section titles move

styles.name: Analog film
styles.hint: Film grain, faded color and polaroid frames. Warm nostalgia.
styles.guidance: Warm faded palette, grain overlay, polaroid/film frames around images, light-leak gradients, typewriter or retro serif accents.
styles.best_for: Photography portfolios, music/vinyl brands, vintage fashion, nostalgia marketing, film industry, cafes
styles.avoid_for: Modern tech, SaaS, healthcare, children's apps, corporate enterprise

recipe.effects: Film grain overlay, VHS tracking effect, polaroid shake, fade-in transitions, light leak animations
recipe.css: filter: sepia() contrast() saturate(0.8), background: noise texture overlay, animation: VHS tracking (transform skew), light leak gradient overlay, border for polaroid frame, grain via SVG filter

styles.name: Raw / hand-made
styles.hint: Hand-drawn marks, collage and scribbles. Human and imperfect on purpose.
styles.guidance: Hand-drawn SVG underlines and arrows, collage placement with small rotations, paper texture, marker annotations; imperfection is intentional.
styles.best_for: Creative portfolios, artist sites, indie brands, handmade products, authentic storytelling, editorial
styles.avoid_for: Corporate enterprise, fintech, healthcare, government, polished SaaS

recipe.effects: No smooth transitions, hand-drawn animations, paper texture overlays, jitter effects, sketch reveal
recipe.css: background: url(paper-texture.png), filter: grayscale() contrast(), border: hand-drawn SVG, transform: rotate(small random), no smooth transitions, sketch-style fonts, opacity variations

styles.name: Accessible first
styles.hint: Large clear text, strong contrast, obvious controls. Easy for everyone.
styles.guidance: Large type (18px+ body), 7:1 contrast where possible, big obvious buttons, thick focus rings, plain language, no motion dependence.
styles.best_for: Government, healthcare, education, inclusive products, large audience, legal compliance, public
styles.avoid_for: None - accessibility universal

recipe.effects: Clear focus rings (3-4px), ARIA labels, skip links, responsive design, reduced motion, 44x44px touch targets
recipe.css: color-contrast: 7:1+, font-size: 16px+, outline: 3-4px on :focus-visible, aria-label, role attributes, @media (prefers-reduced-motion), touch-target: 44x44px, cursor: pointer
checklist: complete-page conformance tested against the chosen target

styles.name: Data-dense
styles.hint: Lots of information per screen, neatly organized. For power users.
styles.guidance: Compact 12-column grid of KPI cards, charts and tables; small gaps, sticky headers, tabular numbers, minimal decoration.
styles.best_for: Business intelligence dashboards, financial analytics, enterprise reporting, operational dashboards, data warehousing
styles.avoid_for: Marketing dashboards, consumer-facing analytics, simple reporting

recipe.effects: Hover tooltips, chart zoom on click, row highlighting on hover, smooth filter animations, data loading spinners
recipe.css: display: grid, grid-template-columns: repeat(12, 1fr), gap: 8-12px, card padding 12-16px, 14px labels and table cells on desktop (16px body on mobile), tables scroll inside their own container, sticky table headers, tabular numbers

styles.name: Soft UI
styles.hint: Gentle depth and soft shadows with clear contrast. Calm and modern.
styles.guidance: Soft multi-layer shadows, 10-12px radii, pale tinted surfaces with real contrast, calm 200-300ms transitions.
styles.best_for: Modern enterprise apps, SaaS platforms, health/wellness, modern business tools, professional, hybrid
styles.avoid_for: Extreme minimalism, critical performance, systems without modern OS

recipe.effects: Improved shadows (softer than flat, clearer than neumorphism), modern (200-300ms), focus visible, measured contrast targets
recipe.css: box-shadow: softer multi-layer (0 2px 4px), background: improved contrast pastels, border-radius: 8-12px, animation: 200-300ms smooth, outline: 2-3px on focus, contrast: 4.5:1+
checklist: Contrast measured against the chosen project target
